segments.text: V. 32. It is greatly obſervable, our LORD has ſo little Regard for one of the higheſt Inſtances of natural Virtue, namely, the returning Love for Love, that He does not account it even to deſerve Thanks. For even ſinners, ſaith He, do the ſame: Men who do not regard GOD at all. Therefore he may do this, who has not taken one Step in Chriſtianity.
